_meta.title: Ventilator Guidelines: Initial ED Mechanical Ventilation

protocol.item: Ventilator Guidelines: Initial ED Mechanical Ventilation

initial_settings: Mode: Volume Control (AC/VC) or Pressure Control (AC/PC)
Tidal Volume (Vt): 6–8 mL/kg predicted body weight (PBW) (4–6 mL/kg in ARDS lung-protective ventilation)
Respiratory Rate (RR): 12–16 breaths/min (titrate for PaCO2 target 35–45 mmHg)
PEEP: 5 cmH2O initial (titrate higher up to 10–14 cmH2O in ARDS/severe hypoxaemia)
FiO2: Start at 100%, rapidly titrate down to lowest FiO2 maintaining SpO2 92–96% (88–92% in hypercapnic COPD)
I:E Ratio: 1:2 standard (1:3 to 1:4 in severe airflow obstruction to prevent auto-PEEP)
high_peak_pressure_troubleshooting: Check Peak Pressure (Ppeak) vs Plateau Pressure (Pplat).
High Ppeak + Normal Pplat (< 30 cmH2O) → Airway Resistance problem: bronchospasm, ETT kink/clot, biting tube, patient-ventilator dyssynchrony.
High Ppeak + High Pplat (> 30 cmH2O) → Lung Compliance problem: pneumothorax, pulmonary oedema, ARDS, mainstem intubation, abdominal distension.

management_steps.details: Confirm tube placement with quantitative ETCO2, bilateral breath sounds, chest expansion, and urgent post-intubation Chest X-Ray.
Connect ventilator. Set initial Vt (6-8 mL/kg PBW), RR 14/min, PEEP 5, FiO2 100%. Adjust FiO2 down promptly once SpO2 target achieved.
Maintain continuous sedation and analgesia (Propofol/Midazolam + Fentanyl infusion) to prevent dyssynchrony and self-extubation.
Perform ABG or VBG 30 minutes post-initiation. Adjust RR for PaCO2/pH and adjust PEEP/FiO2 for PaO2/SpO2.
Complete ICU Consult Form in ED patient file. Contact ICU registrar/consultant on call for admission review.

drugs.notes: 10–50 mcg/kg/min (0.6–3.0 mg/kg/hr) IV infusion for sedation
25–100 mcg/hr IV infusion for analgesia in ventilated patients
1–5 mg/hr IV infusion if propofol contraindicated or hypotensive

warnings: Always monitor Plateau Pressure (Pplat). Keep Pplat ≤ 30 cmH2O to prevent barotrauma/volutrauma.
protocol.disposition: ICU / High Care transfer following consultation and handover.
